name: public-universe
description: Public Universe astronomy tools and skills: explore catalogue data, plan stargazing, explain objects, build lessons and check space facts using a free public MCP server.

defaultPrompt: What can I see tonight from Romsey?
Explain Saturn to a ten-year-old using live catalogue data.
Check the astronomy facts in this worksheet.
interface.longDescription: Explore astronomical catalogue data with seven workflows for stargazers, teachers and writers. Plan an evening, explain an object, build a UK school lesson, check space facts, compare close approaches, draft a weekly sky roundup or audit catalogue data. Tools cover solar-system bodies, sky positions, meteor showers, NASA exoplanets and a galaxy map of host stars. The public MCP service requires no API key. Positions are approximate and are not for telescope control.
